a.lede: A fake cryptocurrency trading app called Padre Terminal, previously available on the Apple App Store for iOS devices, has been linked to the theft of approximately $23,000 from 27 Solana wallets. [...]
a.title: Fake crypto app on Apple App Store linked to $23K wallet theft

b.lede: Prediction market platform Polymarket temporarily suspended trading on Thursday after hackers compromised a third-party service to distribute cryptocurrency-draining JavaScript, with approximately $2.5 million in assets traced to a suspected attacker wallet. [...]
b.title: Polymarket halts trading after crypto-draining script breach, $2.5M traced
